title: Summer camp information
instructions: Kamp görevlisi velilere yaz kampını anlatıyor. Tarih, yaş, fiyat ve gerekenleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: leader
script.text: Thank you for your interest in Lake Camp.

script.speaker: leader
script.text: The camp is for children from nine to fourteen years old.

script.speaker: leader
script.text: It starts on the third of July and lasts for two weeks.

script.speaker: leader
script.text: Children sleep in wooden cabins, six children in each cabin.

script.speaker: leader
script.text: Every day there are activities like swimming, climbing and boat trips.

script.speaker: leader
script.text: The price is four hundred pounds, but brothers and sisters get ten percent off.

script.speaker: leader
script.text: Please don't send mobile phones. Children can call home every Sunday from our office.

questions.feedback: Kamp dokuz ile on dört yaş arası çocuklar için.
questions.evidence: The camp is for children from nine to fourteen years old.

questions.prompt: How many children sleep in each cabin?

options: children who come for one week
questions.feedback: Kardeşlere yüzde on indirim (ten percent off) var.
questions.evidence: brothers and sisters get ten percent off.

questions.feedback: Telefon göndermeyin; çocuklar her pazar ofisten evi arayabilir.
questions.evidence: Children can call home every Sunday from our office.
